digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and command surface
propositions: The bridge needs a store-level mapping recording which tracker projects sync and which repos each project's tickets belong to, stored in .bridge_state/projects.json separate from bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json.

resolve_project must implement a tri-state rule: returning legacy_default for absent ticket keys, None for explicitly empty strings, the project key for set values, and None when legacy_default is itself empty.
bridge projects subcommands (set, list, remove) must be surfaced identically across CLI, library (_lib_ops.py), and MCP layers (list as READ_ONLY read tool, set/remove as write tools).
set --repos is required and idempotent; set --repos "" stores an empty list; set on an existing key replaces rather than merges its repos list.
An absent projects.json record reads as an empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe); a malformed record raises rather than degrading.
The pinned bridge group help (bridge.txt) and argparse metavar verb set must both name the projects verb and remain byte-identical across mapping writes.
